name: Regolith Crawler
behavior: Burrows under Regolith and waits; lunges when a player walks within 3 blocks
drops_text: Crawler Leg 0–2, Regolith Dust 1–3, rare Selenite shard

name: Rust Beetle
java_base: Animal + NeutralMob (tameable, saddle + chest like a llama)
behavior: Grazes on Rust Lichen; rams back when hit; tamed beetles with a Ferrox saddle carry a chest
drops_text: Beetle Grub 0–1, Ferrox bits 1–2, Rust Shell (armor upgrade)

name: Crystal Stag
behavior: Shear the antlers for 1–2 Starlite; they regrow over 5 minutes. Breeds with Starbloom
spawns_text: Cerulon Azure Moss plains, herds of 3–5

name: Prismling
behavior: Swarms in groups; shatters into 2–3 crystal shards on death that deal 1 damage nearby

name: Cinder Hound
damage_text: 4, sets target on fire for 2 s
behavior: Hunts in packs of 3–5; circles, then lunges together. Immune to fire

name: Frost Warden
behavior: Guards the largest wrecks. Phase 2 at half health: summons 2 Rime Stalkers and an ice wall ring
spawns_text: One per large wreck on Eidolon; does not respawn
drops_text: Wraithsteel Ingots 3–5, Frost Warden Helm (trophy), Remnant Shard

name: Flare Sprite
damage_text: 3 fire, or a small fireball at range
behavior: Swarms around Flare Vents; bursts into flame when a vent erupts. Water puts it out instantly
spawns_text: Solvane near Flare Vents, swarms of 4–8

name: Sun Colossus
damage_text: 14 slam; ground wave sets fire in a line
behavior: Wakes when a player steps on its Sunspot Rock plateau. Core opens to take damage after each slam
drops_text: Astrium 4–6, Coronite 6–10, Colossus Core (Fusion Reactor upgrade)

name: Dune Burrower
damage_text: 8; can swallow and hold a player for 2 s
behavior: Travels under sand shown as a moving ripple; bursts up under players who stand still
drops_text: Burrower Steak 1–3, Burrower Scale, Star Map Fragment (rare)

name: Ash Strider
behavior: Wades across lava lakes; rideable with a saddle, making it the lava crossing mount

name: Rime Stalker
behavior: Stalks from behind; only visible within 8 blocks during blizzards
spawns_text: Frozen wastelands; summoned by the Frost Warden

name: Bog Lurker
behavior: Lies submerged in Acid with only eyes showing

name: Crater Drifter
behavior: Floats over craters; drops Meteorite Fragments as it drifts. Attacking one makes nearby drifters swarm

name: Prism Sentinel
behavior: 1: beams bounce off the orbiting shards. 2: shards break loose and circle the arena. 3: core cracks open, and hits to the heart light deal double
spawns_text: Crystal amphitheater on Galaxy 2's key world
drops_text: Galaxy 3 gate key, Cerulite 4–6, Sentinel Prism (T3 lens upgrade)

name: Rift Tyrant
damage_text: Claw 16; rift pull drags you toward the rift
behavior: 1: charges and claws. 2: rift pulls chunks of the arena into the void. 3: spines fire void shards
spawns_text: Fractured island over the void on Galaxy 3's key world
drops_text: Galaxy 4 gate key, Skarnite 4–6, Rift Heart

name: Eidolon Captain
behavior: 1: duels with the cutlass. 2: calls Hollow Crewmen. 3: fleet lantern freezes the deck
spawns_text: Flagship deck on Galaxy 4's key world
drops_text: Galaxy 5 gate key, Eidolite 4–6; Captain's Lantern if spared

name: The Dying Star
behavior: 1: Vael fights from the surface. 2: corona rays sweep the arena. 3: the star collapses, the core opens and the arena shrinks
drops_text: Heart of Solvane, Solvanite 6–8, T6 crown

name: Moon Hopper
behavior: Hops up to 4 blocks high in Moon gravity; flees when hit

name: Dust Grazer
behavior: Grazes in herds; the whole herd stampedes if one is hit

name: Azure Fowl
behavior: Glides slowly when falling; lays a Blue Egg every 5–10 minutes
spawns_text: Cerulon moss plains and Shardwood forests

name: Glimmerfish
behavior: Schools of 4–8; lights the water around it at night

name: Slag Boar
behavior: Roots through Slag; charges if hit or if you get too close to its young

name: Scorch Wyrmling
damage_text: 3 bite; spits a fire bolt (3 + fire)
behavior: Glides between ledges; guards Emberite veins

name: Frost Yak
behavior: Shear for Yak Wool; milk with a glass bottle for Frost Milk. Shelters calves in blizzards

name: Ice Leech
damage_text: 2 and latches on: Hunger II while attached
behavior: Hides under Snowpack; shake it off by sprinting or hitting it

name: Gildcrab
behavior: Walks sideways; basks on Sunspot Rock and is immune to heat

name: Deep Eel
behavior: Lurks in trenches; follows light sources

name: Sand Skitter
behavior: Buries itself in Dunesand; bursts out in groups of 2–3
drops_text: Skitter Leg 1–2, Skitter Carapace 0–1, Venom Gland 0–1
